note: Citations GPTZero flagged as fake that a person then checked by hand. Two kinds. not_found: zero exact-title hits on Europe PMC and no record on Crossref whose title matches, in journals both services index fully. wrong_authors: the title is a real paper, but the record lists different authors from the ones cited. Neither kind proves intent. A reference manager can corrupt a citation too.

candidates.actual: The real paper is by Mahmud, Barua, Habiba and others. Diagnostics, 2024, volume 14, article 345.
